articleTitle: Stabilizing the Transients in the Objects and Systems Controlling the Compensation of Nonlinear ACS (Automatic Control System) Elements
abstract: Any real control system contains one or more associated highly nonlinear elements. The very presence of such elements in automatic control systems causes adverse effects such as reduction in the stability margin, the emergence of self-oscillations (causing a faster wear of mechanisms), as well as greater static error. Improving the quality of transients in automatic control systems (ACS) as well as the techno-economic indicators of control systems by nonlinear control of the ACS processes has served as the necessary basis for creating a software suit based on a fuzzy compensator capable of configuring itself. The paper presents the results of studies into nonlinear elements of automatic control systems; it dwells upon a novel fuzzy approach to compensating the associated nonlinearities. The paper demonstrates the effectiveness of a software module that uses soft computing to automatically configure a fuzzy controller. It presents an example of compensating a nonlinear deadband element; control quality assessments and their comparisons are given.

articleTitle: Improving the Efficiency of Automated Precision Robotics-Enabled Positioning and Welding
abstract: This paper presents the concepts and fragments of algorithmizing the improvement in the quality of welding thin-walled metal products in a robotic manufacturing environment. The proposed solutions will significantly reduce the reject rates applicably to pipelines of complex configuration made for aerospace industries-at the cost of a slightly slower process. The paper proposes an information module for precise configuration of weld workpiece positioning, which minimizes misalignments caused by preparation defects, in particular stamping and pruning defects. The module can run automatically or semiautomatically to support the operator's decision-making. The module can be integrated in the CAM system of a robotic facility thanks to using compatible data formats; as such, it does not require significant extra processing on the part of robot controllers.

articleTitle: Information Technologies and Synthesis of the Management Process Model in the Enterprise
abstract: The development of information technology and the subsequent automation of production, leads to a change in the management process in the enterprise. Accordingly, many areas of production are transferred to an automated level, which entails the need to synthesize the model of the management process in the enterprise, taking into account the current trends in its development.

articleTitle: Features of Registration of Acoustic Signals in Multichannel Acoustic-Emission Systems
abstract: The article describes a method of multichannel recording of acoustic emission signals for monitoring the state of industrial facilities. The front panel of the software package for recording and analyzing signals, implemented on the basis of DAQ devices of the National Instruments company, is presented. The structure and principle of operation of the hardware-software complex is described.

articleTitle: The Method Topological Optimization for Design Linear Electric Machines
abstract: The paper proposes a modern method of topological optimization of material distribution in linear electric machines using a genetic algorithm in combination with grouping by material and the “cleaning” procedure. Linear electric reciprocating machines are widely used in machine-tool construction, aircraft building, oil industry, space and defense industries, electric power industry as part of autonomous power plants, in wave generators, as well as in hybrid cars. It was assumed that the permanent magnet translator has an uncomplicated design for ease of manufacture. The structure of the translator with permanent magnets is designed and manufactured. The manufactured translator has an increased by 24% average electromagnetic force compared to similar machines with the same stator, which proves the effectiveness of this method.

articleTitle: Application of Singular Value Decomposition Method for Acoustic Emission Data Analysis
abstract: The article describes the possibilities of the singular decomposition method in the study of acoustic emission data. Acoustic signals of various nature were used as an object of study. A method of acoustic signals identification based on singular spectrums and additive components contribution is presented in the paper. At the moment, singular spectral analysis method has not practically been considered at acoustic signals researching. The obtained results are fundamentally new and confirm the promise of the method, in particular when solving the identification task.

articleTitle: Finite-Element Model of the Shell-Shaped Half-Pipes Forming for Blanks Behavior Investigating During Corrugating at the Stamping
abstract: The parametrized finite element model of the tooling and sweep of the workpiece has been constructed for the single-pass drawing of half-pipes. An analysis of the current state of the problem of the loss of stability of thin-walled shell-type elements in the plasticity region is carried out. A series of numerical experiments was carried out at different angles of rotation of the channel. The problem of forming thin-walled elements of aviation structures is considered. An estimation of the behavior of a sheet blank during the forming process is given. The stress state of the billet in the process of nucleation and development of the corrugation was investigated. The data on the stresses arising in the potentially defective zone and in the region free from the appearance of folds are compared.

articleTitle: The Finite Element Simulation of the Stamping Die Optimal Topology
abstract: The problem associated with the development of specialized equipment for the production of sheet elements of aircraft structures is considered, taking into account the use of layer-by-layer growth capabilities, optimization of the rig die using finite element analysis. Finite element modeling of the tooling used as a tool for sheet stamping was carried out. In the work it is proposed to use as a tooling a model of plastic material obtained by layer-by-layer growing. As a structure of rigging, various grid structures were considered, an estimation of the strong properties of this structure was made under the conditions of the impact of the load from the press. In addition, a comparative analysis of models of optimized snap-ins constructed by layer-by-layer growth of the grid structure and topological optimization due to material redistribution, based on loading conditions. Analysis of the stress-strain state of the stamp is carried out.

articleTitle: Study of Thermal Exchange with Liquid Flowing in a Cylindrical Channel
abstract: This article considers the sequence for obtaining the approximate analytical solution for the non-stationary problem of heat exchange in liquids moving in cylindrical conduit (the Graetz-Nusselt problem). The solution was obtained based on Fourier's variable separation method with involving the additional boundary conditions. The physical sense of the additional boundary conditions consists in complying with the original differential equation in the boundary point of the transverse space variable (in the conduit center). It is demonstrated that the proposed approach allows obtaining simple-form approximate analytical solutions with the accuracy being sufficient for engineering applications. Therefore, in the range of <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathbf{x}\pmb{\geq 0.01}$</tex>, the deviation between the obtained results and the accurate solution already in the fourth approximation is not higher than 3%. It is noted that considerable calculation differences occur in obtaining the accurate analytical solutions for small values of longitudinal coordinate.

articleTitle: The Study of Periodic Effects on Parameters of Hydrolytospheric Processes
abstract: In this paper we present a mathematical model of the hydrolytospheric process, verify the mathematical model and demonstrate the results of the study of the level change of the hydrolytospheric process caused by periodic variations in the flow rate of the producing well.

articleTitle: The Application of Transport Telematics for the Organization of an Innovative System for the Organization of the Technical Maintenance of Vehicles
abstract: The article describes the method to determine real exploitable rates of fuel consumption in cargo vehicles. The significance of incoming dataflow influence on actual fuel consumption in cargo vehicles considering their technical state, maintenance service, cargo weight, speed and traffic condition was identified; the reasons for increased fuel consumption of cargo vehicles were determined; algorithm for evaluation of fuel consumption basing on a massive dataflow from telematics control systems was developed.

articleTitle: Development of a Comprehensive Criterion for Evaluating the Ergonomics Configuration of the Seat
abstract: The article is devoted to the development of a complex criterion for assessing the ergonomics of unsupported planting on the stool. The problems that lead to the violation of human posture are indicated. The issue of seat ergonomics is considered. The characteristic advantages of unsecured seats and their shortcomings are singled out. An analysis of ergonomics studies is presented for long-term sitting. The components for assessing the comfort of planting a person on a chair are determined. The integral criterion of a complex evaluation of seat ergonomics is formulated, which simultaneously takes into account the distribution of contact pressures and the location of the projection of the center of gravity of the body on the contact spot.

Author Keywords: the interaction of humans with the surface of seat
evaluation of the comfort level of the seat
the distribution of contact pressures on the seat

articleTitle: An Analysis of Fires Due to Violation of the Rules for Design and Operation of Electrical Plants, and How to Prevent them in Residential Buildings (on the Example of the Amur Region)
abstract: The paper presents the studies on the dynamics of fires in the Amur Region for the period from 2006 to 2016. The studies involved an analysis of main causes of their occurrence and damage. It is shown that most of the fires occur due to the violation of the Rules for design and operation of electrical plants (VRDOEP) in residential and industrial buildings. It is established that the phase currents in the 0.38 kV electrical networks are objectively considerably unbalanced, which leads to the zero-sequence currents in the neutral conductor of the three-phase electrical network and corresponding overheating of this conductor. This, in turn, leads to the destruction of the insulation of the neutral and phase conductors and corresponding single-phase short circuits. As a result, conditions for fires arise. The ways, methods and engineering solutions for preventing fires caused by violation of the Rules for operation of electrical installations are analyzed. The analysis demonstrates that the most effective engineering solution is the use of special balancing devices that significantly reduce the zero-sequence current in the neutral conductor and, accordingly, prevent its overheating. A technique for determining the parameters of balancing devices is proposed.

articleTitle: Modeling the Operation of the System in the CODESYS Software Environmentper
abstract: Nowadays the world seeks to automate all branches of life. Automation plays a significant role in large-scale manufacturing, due to the large volume of production. Complex processes that have many controlled and testing parameters are difficult to implement by a team of workers. There is also a human factor that can disrupt the process. To solve this problem, programmable logical controllers (PLCs) were created that took on the role of a “brain” in a controlled system. The task of the controller is to evaluate all the factors of the system and to correct its operation to perform the given mode. So, all automation systems are built. Each process has its own peculiarities and mode. The PLC runs on the program loaded into it, which corresponds to the selected process. Correct writing of the program is one of the main tasks in the design of the system. The article discusses the programming environment of CoDeSys controllers, which makes it possible for any specialist, with the help of logical operations in a different view, to compile a program for any process. Writing the program is possible in any convenient format: in the language of relay contact circuits, in the graphical language of functional block charts, and also with the help of high-level diagrams describing the stages and conditions of the transitions in the contemporary computer programming language. In addition, the complex CoDeSys makes it possible for you to see the program in operation, using the visualization editor. Visualization is possible without connecting the PLC. In this article, an example of using the CoDeSys complex to develop a simulation program for the batching and blending process of a glass charge is considered. In the work, various ways of modeling the process are presented for a more illustrative demonstration of the system operation and debugging of the controller. When the flow chart of this process is constructed, a visualization of the process is carried out by means of a graphical display of the state of the equipment and subprocesses. The result of this work is the disclosure of the capabilities of the software complex CoDeSys for use by specialists in the field of automation of control systems for the management of technological processes and production in construction. The complex is associated with the development, commissioning, adjustment of the automated process control system. The application of this software complex in Russia has a tendency of steady growth. A program developed for a specific process in CoDeSys can be easily verified using graphical modeling and is available for adjustment directly in the process of operation, taking into account the process change. It is also advantageous that the CoDeSys complex with instruction for its use is freely available, which makes it possible to use freely this tool, adapt it to any technological process. The main thing is to understand what kind of tool it is and what opportunities it provides.

articleTitle: Justification of Optimum Volumes of Mining and Reserves of Iron Ore for the Sustainable Development of Enterprises of Mineral Raw Material Complex
abstract: One of the most important factors in the development of the state is the attraction of investments in the real sector of the economy, especially in the mineral and raw materials sector, on which the country's mining and partly manufacturing industries are based. The mineral and raw materials complex of Russia provides more than 50% of the revenue of the budget and more than 70% of foreign exchange earnings from sales. Under whatever scenario the development of the domestic economy was built, its implementation is impossible without raw materials [1]. This applies to oil and gas raw materials, which are the basis of the country's export potential, as well as to rare-earth elements, without which it is practically impossible to build an innovative economy. The relevance of the presented research is the formation of multifactorial models of production and reserves by types of raw materials, which are characterized by the highest repayment rates in the Central Federal District (CFD). The author's methodology is universal, so it can be applied to other economic regions and to different types of raw materials.

articleTitle: Mathematical Modeling of Vibrations of an Elastic Shell Under the Influence of Ground
abstract: Nowadays, in the era of modern technologies, when the route of a cable or pipeline can be reflected using $\pmb{3}\mathbf{D}$ modeling with the GPS reference, unfortunately, the question of whether the connection is hidden on a particular section of the structure or not remains extremely urgent. Prospecting, laying new communications with digging trenches and channels, laying hidden messages by the method of horizontally directed drilling (HDD) are often exposed to failures or performed with significant financial costs due to the lack of information or accidental damaging of power cable lines and pipelines. At the same time, the scope of the tasks of contractors is limited not only by the performance of construction and repair work, but also by providing detailed information (plans, maps and diagrams) about the place of lying of the engineering networks. To avoid such situations, it is necessary to monitor the location of engineering communications. In this article, the new method for monitoring the location of buried pipelines was proposed, and mathematical modeling was performed in the ANSYS program for finite elements, which confirms the effectiveness of the proposed technical solution.

articleTitle: Advantages of Using the Probabilistic Form of Information Representation in Information-Control Systems
abstract: The article considers the basic possibility of applying the probabilistic form of information representation in information-control systems with the purpose of significant reduction of hardware volume, increase of their speed and noise immunity. The questions of transformation of information into probabilistic form are considered, the mathematical apparatus describing the direct and the reverse transformation of information into probabilistic form is briefly resulted. The principles of constructing computing devices - stochastic or probabilistic computers, in which the information is transmitted, transformed and processed in the form of signals of various nature, are presented in the form of probabilistic displays. The analysis of the advantages obtained by using the probabilistic form of information representation in the information-control systems from the point of view of saving hardware volume is carried out.

articleTitle: The System of Selection and Sale of Ready-to-Wear Clothes in a Virtual Environment
abstract: An important task of modern sewing production is the creation of an effective tool for the operative retrieval and transformation of digital information on the features of the shape of a person's figure and a comparison of the data obtained with the dimensions of the garments produced for selecting garments with a high quality of planting. The article presents a system of virtual interaction between the garment industry and buyers by organizing online sales of manufactured clothes and presenting industrial collections on the Internet. The basic principle of the developed application is based on the use of a three-dimensional model of a person, determining the spatial dimensional features of a figure, revealing the relationship between the design parameters of clothing and the dimensional characteristics of the figure. The uniform criteria of comparison of parameters of clothes, patterns, sketch and figure of the person among themselves are offered. The system analyzes the external shape and anthropometric characteristics of the figure and determines the appropriate products from the assortment of the store.

articleTitle: Formation of Interaction Model in the Management System of the Mineral Wealth Fund of Common Mineral Resources
abstract: Mineral resources potential is the basis for a sustainable and balanced development of the modern economy in the case of its rational and integrated use across the entire spectrum of the diversity of minerals' types represented. The current system of subsoil management at the federal and regional levels is considered from the point of view of interaction in the part of solving the problem of accounting and information support for common mineral resources. The methodological base of the research is the use of structural analysis and design methodology in the IDEF0 notation using the Ramus software. With the contextual diagram of the functional model of the subsoil management process, the place and role of territorial geoinformation analytical system of geological and economic monitoring in the structure of management of the state fund of subsurface resources is determined. The subsequent decomposition of management process made it possible to detail the powers of management bodies of the subsoil fund within the framework of the geoinformation analytical system in terms of management level of the subsoil fund. In the result it is concluded that to solve the problems of interaction of Federal and regional authorities in the sphere of common mineral resources, the creation of a territorial geoinformation systems of geological and economic monitoring is required, that has a hierarchical multilayer structure with the purpose of cooperation of various authorities and subsoil users to increase management efficiency of mineral raw material complex, which will contribute to: standardization of information exchange ways, formation of a unified methodological base of geological-economic information of legal acts and standards; development of regional funds of geological-economic information; form on the territory of the region of cluster economic structures built taking into account the available natural and mineral potentials, which are the locomotives of regional economy development.

articleTitle: Simulation Modeling of Transport Flows of Copper Deposit
abstract: This paper describes the management of the transport system of copper deposit on the basis of the simulation model developed with Arena 14.0 (Rockwell Automation). The paper gives the review of methods used to study the transport system of the mining enterprise; describes the simulation model of dump trucks moving along pendulum routes in the copper mine. The paper also analyses the alternative methods of arranging the overburden transportation from the mining area. The study was conducted using the following methods: systematic calculation methods with the elements of discrete mathematics, discrete event simulation modelling with Arena 14.0 (Rockwell Automation). A computer-based experiment was carried out to select the optimal way of transportation of copper ore from the mining area to the ore processing plant. As a result of this experiment the detailed statistics were obtained describing the main parameters of the transport system performance, such as volume of the mine rock being transported, transport utilization rate, downtime percentage, average number of dump truck haul cycles, etc. The developed simulation model enables to study the complex system in real time and optimize the number and characteristics of transport, thus ensuring the efficient management of the transport system.

articleTitle: The Main Limitations of Applying Blockchain Technology in the Field of Education
abstract: The article identifies the main features of the application of blockchain technology, which caused a lot of positive feedback in scientific circles and professional communities. After success in the financial market, where the blockchain contains blocks that are iced in the chain, which describes absolutely all transactions with virtual coins (such as Bitcoin, Litecoin, Ethereum and others), there were prospects for evaluating the possibility of its successful application in other areas. Considering that the sphere of education in Russia is going through a period of reforms, special attention is paid to the opportunities and problems of application in this sphere. The article discusses the effectiveness of the application of blockchain technology for the distributed registry and for mass application in the field of education. And also an estimation of the probability of the possibility of improving the educational process. The analysis of the advantages of the technology that allowed it to successfully spread its crypto currency in the market of anonymous transactions and their application in the subject field of education, in comparison with classical technologies, with the central node-regulator, for example, the client-server.

articleTitle: Structural and Parametric Investigations of Oxy-Fuel Combustion Cycles with the Aim of Increasing Efficiency of Electricity Production
abstract: This study aims to present the results of thermodynamic analysis and optimization of the E-MATIANT cycle. The design parameters of the cycle are set up on the basis of the component technologies of today's state-of-the-art gas turbines with a turbine inlet temperature between 1100°C and 1700°C. The optimal pressure ratio ranges for the considered turbine inlet temperatures are identified and a comparison with existing evaluations is made. For the optimal initial parameters E-MATIANT net efficiency varies from 42.0 to 49.8% without considering turbine cooling. An influence of additional reheat in combustor chamber on cycle efficiency was identified. Two turbine cooling schemes are proposed. The maximum net efficiency of E-MATIANT cycle, which is equal to 44.0%, is obtained for turbine inlet temperature equal to 1400°C and turbine inlet pressure equal to 40 bar taking into account turbine cooling. An influence of water injection in coolant flow on cycle efficiency was estimated. The performance penalty due to the oxygen production and carbon dioxide capture is examined.

articleTitle: Issues of and Outlook for Using Geothermal Water
abstract: The article presents the findings of the study of the Georgievskoe deposit of geothermal waters. The methodology for estimating the energy potential of a water-bearing horizon (an aquifer) is demonstrated. The interrelation between the amount of energy extracted, the rate of thermal water intake and the lowering of the level in the aquifer is considered. General questions of constructing control systems for hydrolytospheric processes are considered.

articleTitle: Use of Rapeseed Oil and Water Emulsion as Diesel Fuel
abstract: The necessity of using biofuels in internal combustion engines is proved. Advantages of using emulsified fuels in diesel engines are shown. The comparative analysis of physical and chemical properties of petroleum diesel fuel and rapeseed oil and water emulsion is carried out. The results of experimental research of the diesel engine running on these fuels are presented. The object of research is the diesel engine of an automotive type D-243. Research of the diesel engine was carried out on the petroleum diesel fuel and the emulsion of 90% petroleum diesel fuel and of 10 % of water. An opportunity of improving environmental characteristics of the diesel engine running on rapeseed oil and water emulsion is shown. The results showed that the use of the emulsified fuel leads to the significant reduction of the exhaust gases smoke opacity. By the high load mode the transition from petroleum diesel fuel to emulsified fuel leads to decrease of exhaust gases smoke opacity by 26-42%. By operating on emulsified fuel significant reduction of nitrogen oxides emission is noted. At the modes with high loads it makes 8-13 %. At the same time concentration of unburned hydrocarbons in the exhaust gases decreases 1.5-2.5 times. The carbon monoxide emissions growth marked by testing the diesel engine on emulsified fuel can easily be corrected by installing a catalytic converter in the engine exhaust system. In general, the carried out experimental studies have confirmed the prospects of using the rapeseed oil and water emulsion as fuel for the diesel engine.

articleTitle: Flexible Systems for the Transmission of Electrical Energy Over Long Distances
abstract: Object: Transport of electrical energy over long distances based on flexible power transmission systems using a thyristor voltage regulator. Methods: Transportation of electric power of an alternating current to ultra-long distances is possible by compensating or half-wave (tuned to half-wave) power transmission. Findings: In order to transmit electric power with alternating current to long-distance and ultra-long distances, half-wave power transmission should be preferred, since they do not require additional costs for reactive power compensation and, at the same time, have increased capacity. However, the advisability of tuning to a half-wave occurs when the line length is 1500 km or more. The line, which is less than 1500 km long, should be brought to the line of “zero length”. The reactance of the line, the length of which is less than the boundary length, that is, less than 1500 km, is proposed to be compensated and lead to a “zero” length line to increase throughput and stabilize the voltage regime along the line with the help of a thyristor parameter stabilizer developed at the Institute of Physical and Technical Problems of the North them. V.P. Larionov. Conclusions: A trunk line is proposed in the north, providing the centralized electricity supply to the new industrial centers of the northern and arctic regions of the Republic of Sakha (Yakutia). A new method for constructing extended power transmission in an understated voltage class based on high-current electronics was developed.

articleTitle: The Algorithm of Document Classification of Research and Education Institution Using Machine Learning Methods
abstract: Currently, there are many classification technologies based on machine learning and artificial intelligence. However, a sufficient theoretical basis for the integration of existing classification methods for the analysis of documents of scientific and educational institutions is not developed. Within the framework of the research provided in the article, an algorithm of classification of documents is formed, taking into account the specifics of the documents of the subject area of scientific and educational institution. The system of characteristics, by which the documents can be grouped to solve the problem of combined classification, is also presented. The article considers the approach of preprocessing text allowing the use of well-known methods of machine learning to improve the accuracy and speed of documents classification. Thus, the conducted research can be used to solve the problem of classification of documents in electronic document management systems of scientific and educational institutions.

articleTitle: The Creation of a Low-Capacity Boiler Plant on Coal-Enrichment Waste
abstract: A serious problem for coal production is the environmentally friendly utilization of coal mining waste and coal enrichment. In different countries, the best specialists in this field are trying to find the solution of this problem. In the United States, France and China, the technology of preparation and burning of water-coal suspensions (WCS) for the utilization of fine-dispersed wastes of coal enrichment and coal slurries has been successfully used. A boiler with a thermal capacity of 0.63 MW with a vortex combustion system efficiently operating on fuel from coal waste was designed, manufactured and tested. The results of the operation of the boiler on this fuel showed its high efficiency (the efficiency is 83-86%) with the level of harmful emissions in the flue gases below the permissible values

Author Keywords: a boiler with a vortex combustion system

articleTitle: Classification of Methods for Forming Surfaces When Machining Parts on Machine Tools
abstract: The article discusses the directions of development of Computer Integrated Manufacturing (CIM) and the problems that arise. The authors consider the most promising direction of the creation of information systems for the automatic create of technological processes to be based on the CAD model. This direction involves the development of theoretical positions, the formalization of requirements and processes for create of technology. In the article presented, the authors consider issues related to create of technology of machining parts by cutting. The main tasks have been determined, solving in the process create of technology for the formation of the geometric part configuration. The authors propose an original classification of surfaces formation methods. A simple set of shaping motions corresponds to each method taking into account the configuration of the cutting edge of the tool. Classification is one of the steps in the development of the theory of synthesis of all possible kinematic schemes of machining parts surfaces.

articleTitle: The Technique of the Optimization of the Process of the Rehabilitation of the Spine Based on the Individual Information Model of the Spine
abstract: The paper describes the technique of the optimizing of the process of the rehabilitation of the human spinal on the basis of the individual information model. The proposed model allows to reflect the functional features of the patient's nervous system. The information model interacts with the angular biomechanical model of the musculoskeletal system and takes into account human neuro-mechanics. The individual information model of the patient in conjunction with the recorded abnormalities of the parameters of the movements from the norm are used to assess the disease of the nervous system and the localization of the pathology site. Based on the received evaluations, the rehabilitation process, including rehabilitation exercises, adapts to the patient's characteristics in an automated mode. The effectiveness of rehabilitation is enhanced by activation of the feedbacks of the nervous system during the exercise of the formed rehabilitation technique.

articleTitle: Digital Differential Protection of the «Generator-Transformer» Block
abstract: This article discusses methods of lowering the influence of aperiodic components on operation of digital relay protection of generators by units “generator-transformer”. We show that there are four possible selections for excluding the false operation of relay protection determined by saturation of magnetic conductors in current transformers and existence in short-circuit currents in aperiodic components. Features of relay protection of block “generator-transformer” in case of change of transformation coefficient of the transformer are considered. Authors propose the alternative method of separation of odd harmonics in currents of switching on of power transformers after switch-off of short circuits.

Author Keywords: aaperiodic component of current of short circuit
saturation of magnetic conductors of transformers of current
allocation from current of short circuit of a periodic component of industrial frequency

articleTitle: Features Selection for Human Activity Recognition in Telerehabilitation
abstract: The article considers the problem of features selection for human activity recognition in telerehabilitation. The notion of telerehabilitation is considered. The types of physical activity that are necessary to conduct a telerehabilitation are indicated. A method for carrying it out using wearable devices is proposed. It is proposed to use a smartphone, which includes an accelerometer and a gyroscope to determine the physical activity performed by the patient. A literature review of approaches to the recognition of physical activity types is given. An experiment to select such features for the classification of physical activity that would allow for high classification accuracy with minimal computational costs, regardless of the location of the smartphone on the human body is carried out. As a means of carrying out the experiment, the MATLAB environment was used. For the experiment an open data sets has been used, which contains data from the sensors of the smartphone.

articleTitle: Dynamics of Gas Bearings of Turbomachines
abstract: One way of increasing the frequency of rotation of rotor machines, including, in particular, include turbo-machine, is to install them on gas-static bearings. Turbo-machine with gas bearings have found wide application in the Metalworking, gyroscopes, precision instrumentation, gas compressor stations, etc., what attracts researchers to study the characteristics of their work. The aim of this work is to study the influence of operational and design parameters of gas-static bearings on its dynamic characteristics. The research on contactless bearings, are connected mainly with the study of statistical properties. Therefore, research aimed at improving the stability of the bearings of high-speed machines are, indeed, relevant. The paper presents comparison of results of theoretical and experimental studies of dynamic characteristics of gas-static bearings. The presented method of calculation of the characteristics and experimental studies, as well as ways to reduce vibration and enhance stable operation of turbo machines for gas-static bearings.

articleTitle: The Method of Automatic Determination of the Types of Spatial Angles in 3D Models of CAD Systems
abstract: The Article is devoted to the presentation of the methodology proposed by the author for the automated determination of the type of angles (edges) on solids in 3D models created in CAD systems. The proposed technique simplifies the solution of problems of automation of search of necessary objects for fillets, processing, etc.in 3D models of design systems when creating software modules that process (or analyze) these models at the level of software complexes of various intelligent systems. The article presents an algorithm that implements the proposed method for programming systems embedded in CAD modules, and criteria for determining the type of the investigated 3D body angle. In conclusion, we present a workable example of how to implement a technique for CAD system Siemens NX in C++ using the basic functions of the built-in software library Open API.

articleTitle: The Implementation Method of Application Program Interface for Manipulator Mitsubishi RV-2FB
abstract: The method of implementation of program interface for industrial manipulator on the base of web-technology is proposed in this paper. This program interface can be used for creating distributed control systems of industrial robots. The actuality of solved task is defined by necessity of integration standard industrial equipment with external intelligent system of data processing and control in conditions of uncertainty working environment. In paper the architecture of program interface on the base of modern framework Vue.js for developing web-applications and Flask library is described. The using this framework allows to create interactive user interfaces which satisfy the real-time control conception.

articleTitle: Energy Saving at Modernization of Street Lighting
abstract: The article is devoted to the practical energy saving at modernization of street lighting in small towns. The object of the research is street lighting. The subject of the research is replacing the lamp type and power. The paper deals with the current situation of street lighting on the basis of the existing RKU (mercury console street) type with DRL (arc mercury) 250W lamps. The modern software products allowed to hold computer modeling of street lighting and calculation of standardized parameters for the option of using ZhKU (sodium console) lighting with DNat (high-pressure sodium) 150W lamps. There has been made a lighting calculation of a road section with the existing RKU-250 lamps and a comparative lighting calculation with ZhKU-150 lamps. There is a graphic performance of 2D and 3D lighting models of the test road section. The normative GOST value of the average luminance is demonstrated. There has been made a calculation of basic lighting parameters (average brightness, average luminance, maximum luminance, minimum luminance). There is information about financial cost of street lighting modernization. There has been calculated the annual economic impact of replacing DRL 250W lamps with DNat 150W lamps. There has been made a calculation of the payback period of the project. The energy-saving effect has been received. The further introduction of replacement of DRL 250W lamps with DNat 150W lamps has been recommended.

articleTitle: One Approach to the Design of Digital Educational Resources for the Training of Personnel in Power Industry
abstract: The relevance of the software product of digital educational resources assessment for the purpose of their further integration into educational process is proved in the article. The basic principles of the procedure of their search are defined. The ranging principle of results of information search is determined. A description of the data model for storing search results is provided. Features of operating in the web applications created by means of a framework of ASP.NET on the basis of the Model-view-controller template and with assistance of technology of cast and authentication of Identify ASP.NET are considered by data. The main screen forms showing work of system of thematic search are given.

articleTitle: Experimental Studies of the Process of Obtaining Biogas from Wastes from Agricultural Enterprises
abstract: At present, alternative energy systems are widely used in many countries of the world. One of the promising areas of alternative energy is the production of biogas from the organic waste of agricultural enterprises. To study the biogas production process, an experimental setup with a bioreactor of 5 liters was developed. A series of full-scale experiments on the effect of the composition of the initial substrate on the qualitative and quantitative composition of biogas was carried out. As the substrate used: corn silage, poultry manure, pig manure and manure of cattle. Dependences of the volume of biogas and methane content on the type of substrate being processed and the temperature of the process are obtained. It has been established that the greatest amount of biogas is released during fermentation of corn silage and avian manure, and the smallest of pig manure drains. The greatest content of methane is observed when processing bird droppings - 64%, and the smallest of corn silage - 50%.

articleTitle: Development of an Information System for Organizing and Monitoring the Educative Process of Students on the Basis of Cloud Technologies
abstract: The article considers the development of an information system for organizing and monitoring the educative process of students on the basis of cloud technologies. In the course of the research, the analysis of the requirements of the standards for the information and educational environment, the analysis of factors affecting the quality of the learning process, the analysis of the elements of the process of organizing and monitoring the students' education, analysis of popular cloud services, SWOT-analysis of the information system were carried out. The main results of the research are presented in the article. As a result of the research, an information system for organizing and monitoring the educative process of students on the basis of cloud technologies has been developed. This system meets all the requirements mentioned above. It includes an electronic journal of students' progress and attendance records, methodological materials and tasks for self-study of disciplines, a testing system, communication with teachers, a calendar of events and other elements

articleTitle: Research of Efficient Burning of Bark and Wood Fuel
abstract: The efficient combustion of bark and wood fuel in the combustion furnaces of medium-pressure steam boilers “KM-75-40” and “Tampella-Carlson” which have worked more than 50 years were considered. The aim and objectives of the study were stated. Comprehensive energy survey of boilers was carried out when combustion of biofuel mixture with a moisture content of 56.7%, mass fraction of sawdust was about 42%. Components of the heat balance and emissions were determined. Ash particle size distribution for the content of combustibles was carried out. Porous structure of coke particles was studied using an Autosorb-iQ-MP automatic analyzer by nitrogen adsorption. A verage diameter, specific surfaces and pore volumes were determined. It is shown that carbon particles carried away from the combustion chambers of boilers with the size of 0.25 mm and larger are a sorbent similar in properties to activated carbons. Therefore, it is advisable and technically possible to separate this fraction and then use it to clean wastewater and exhaust gases. State of the enclosing surfaces of the boilers was checked by thermovision inspection. Recommendations are elaborated to improve the energy and environmental performance of the surveyed boilers.

articleTitle: Information Technologies of Automation of Motor Grader Control in the Soil Processing with Changes of the Capture Angle of the Blade
abstract: Based on the consideration of the existing difficulties with the control of the working process of the motor grader, a system of automatic control of the working body of the motor grader according to a parameter characterizing the efficiency of the working process while providing the high quality of the surface obtained after the passage is proposed. The algorithm of automatic control of the capture angle of the blade of the motor grader in the process of cutting and moving the soil along the parameter characterizing the current productivity is presented. An imitating model of the motor grader's work was developed for cutting and moving the soil with the proposed automatic control system for changing the angle of capture of the oblique blade of the motor grader. Investigations were made and the results of estimating the spread of the widths of the resulting web of the finished soil surface were obtained, on the basis of which conclusions were made about the possibility of using the developed automation system of the motor grader working process in the construction industry.

articleTitle: Automation of the Production of Cottage Cheese Using the Ultrafiltration Method
abstract: The level of self-provision of the population of the Russian Federation with milk and dairy products is one of the key indicators of the food security state. However, the current value of this criterion is lower than the necessary one. In this regard, the issue of increasing domestic products competitiveness, the new products development alongside with traditional ones with new consumer properties is acute. The ultrafiltered cottage cheese is among these products. This article is devoted to the automation of its production. It describes the main technological stages of obtaining cottage cheese. The membrane equipment used in the project is described. The detailed requirements to the information functions of the automated process control system and to the automatic control systems are given. The composition of information and executive channels is described. The technical means used in the project are listed. The effects of implementing the proposed automation project are described.

articleTitle: Energy Saving in the Main Gas Pipeline Transport
abstract: A significant part of the produced gas is transported by trunk pipeline transport. The issue of reducing hydraulic losses during gas transportation is an urgent task for reducing gas transportation enterprise's expenses for their own technological needs. In this paper, we consider the possibility of increasing the energy efficiency of gas transport through the use of an antifriction smooth surface coating of the inner surface of linear sections. Currently, such coatings are used quite rarely due to a significant increase in capital costs for the construction of main gas pipelines. In the course of the study it was shown that the use of these materials can be economically feasible when used not along the entire length of the pipeline, but only in its last sections. This is due to the fact that during the transportation of gas there is a change in the density of the transport medium in the course of travel, which leads to an increase in the flow velocity. Thus, the largest specific losses fall on the last linear sections of the pipeline. The use of pipes with antifriction coating on these sections will allow us to obtain substantially shorter payback periods than for the whole gas pipeline as a whole. This will save energy on the drive of the superchargers of the compressor station or position them at a greater distance from each other.

articleTitle: Numerical Investigation of the Effect of Obstacles on the Thermal Exchange and Mixing Efficiency of Fluids in Microchannels
abstract: Fast and effective mixing of substances is necessary for the operation of most microchannel devices used in chemistry and biology. Therefore, the creation and optimization of micro mixers with the shortest mixing time is relevant task in the development of microchannel devices. Heat exchange of microscopic quantities of liquid is also important in many applications. One way to intensify mixing and heat exchange in microchannels is to use different obstacles. Therefore the processes of mixing and heat exchange in a T -shaped microchannel with obstacles of various shapes: square, rhomboid, rectangular and rectangular cut were considered in this paper. The obstacles were located in the central part of the mixing channel. In the same area, the heat dissipated on the bottom wall of the channel with heat flux of 0.014 W, which was equal to 100 kW/m2 of heat flux density for the microchannel without the obstacles. The Reynolds number was ranged from 10 to 300. The heat transfer coefficient and mixing efficiency, as well as the pressure difference in the mixing channel were obtained as a result. These values were compared with such for a microchannel without obstacles. It was shown an increase in both the mixing efficiency and the heat transfer coefficient for all the considered obstacles configurations.

articleTitle: Method of Monitoring the State of Communication Networks
abstract: The authors of the article suggest the method that allows to optimize the volume of stored and transmitted data of monitoring results with the saving of the maximum level of observability of the monitored parameters.

articleTitle: Theoretical and Practical Aspects of Implementing Automated Energy Control and Metering Systems for Commercial Accounting
abstract: The relevance and special importance of power consumption and energy-saving issues for sustainable development of energy strategy for Russia and the world community determine the need for their detailed elaboration at both theoretical and practical levels. The key factor of unsustainable costs is losses that occur during energy transportation from a supplier to a consumer. These costs will be reduced by the introduction of an automated energy control and metering systems for commercial accounting (AECMSCA) for the implementation of one-time, continuous, automatic control and organization of commercial payments between suppliers and consumers of energy. An introduction of ASCM is a prerequisite for the transition to payment of differentiated electricity rates. It is a strategic goal of improving the efficiency of country's energy potential. This article gives theoretical rationale for implementing AECMSCA for carrying out measurements, collecting, processing and storage of results of measurements, information on conditions of objects and measuring instruments, automatic transmission of information obtained to an integrated automated system of commercial accounting management at the wholesale electricity market. We characterize some practical aspects of AECMSCA implementation in the Far East of the Russian Federation, in particular, in the “South-Yakutsk electrical networks” subsidiary. The final result of the work on upgrading electricity metering systems will be a full (100 per cent) automated data collection on consumed electricity from all metering devices. In the project under consideration, the overall economic benefits due to introduction of AECMSCA will be up to 10 % of the amount of consumed energy.

Author Keywords: automated information and measuring system of commercial electricity metering
automated system of commercial metering of energy resources

articleTitle: Energy-Saving Electric Equipment Applied in Agriculture
abstract: The article considers the results of the work conducted by the scientists of the Chair of Automatic Electric Drive of Izhevsk State Agricultural Academy on the development of an energy&cost efficient LED irradiator for meristematic potato plants. This irradiator consists of multicolored LEDs. To control the dose of spectral components of a photosynthetically active radiation zone, a programmable logical controller (PLC) is used. The authors provide the results of the experiments, demonstrating that the irradiator application reduces electrical energy consumption by 70...80% and decreases the periods of potato plant growing in test tubes by 4 days.

articleTitle: Improvement of Efficiency of Geothermal Power Plants by Using Hydrogen Combustion Technologies
abstract: Thermodynamic analysis of the integrated single-and double-flash power plant is performed in order to estimate possible gain from a hydrogen superheating of a secondary steam with the use of 50 MW Mutnovsky GeoPP-1 as an example. Hydrogen superheating of the steam flow in the second flash cycle with the high temperature steam from hydrogen-oxygen steam generator can increase steam temperature at turbine by 20-30 $\mathbf{K}$ and increase steam quality at turbine outlet by 2-4<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">%</sup>. Additional available power can be increased by 5-10% (0.5-0.9 MW) and efficiency of the plant can be increased from 10.0% to 12.1%. The best effect for improvement of the steam cycle of Mutnovsky GeoPP-1 is obtained for temperatures below 100°C and combined double-flash binary plant with hydrogen steam superheating is proposed.

articleTitle: Dynamics Pressure Measurement in the Unit for Continuous Steam Explosion Treatment of Wood Biomass with a System of Plunger Hydraulic Locks
abstract: This article presents the dynamic performance of the unit for continuous steam explosion treatment of woody biomass with a system of plunger hydraulic locks. The presented data allows estimating peak loads on elements in time. Comparison of pressure data in different parts of the device allows one to monitor the process and optimize it automatic system.

articleTitle: Adaptive Intellectual Decision Support System for Assessing Changes in Information States of Objects in Cloud Computing Environments
abstract: The purpose of monitoring the state of the objects of the cloud computing environment is to ensure their effective functioning. With the purpose of developing known statistical methods for monitoring the state of objects, a scientific approach is proposed that makes it possible to minimize errors of the 1st and 2nd kind when assessing the state of objects, compress large amounts of data without losing their informativeness based on the use of the Kulbak information measure. This approach largely allows satisfying the requirements for the implementation of known methods for monitoring the state of objects in the cloud computing environment. These requirements include: processing large amounts of current information to adjust the parameters of the control and management system; decision-making on the results of processing in real time; timely detection of possible precritical conditions of objects that may be associated with great economic damage or even catastrophic consequences.

articleTitle: Methods of Remote Sensing in Forest Fund Assessment Problems
abstract: The paper considers the main tasks related to the assessment of the state of the forest fund. Existing and proposed new models of assessment of the state of the forest fund by remote sensing methods are investigated, on the basis of which a field is built, where each region is assigned a certain set of characteristics. The analysis of the constructed field allows us to identify critical areas (fire, deadwood, cutting) that correspond to the state of the assessed surface. The overlapping of different models revealing the current state allows to give a comprehensive assessment of the status of the monitoring zone.

articleTitle: Joint Work of Two Mobile Robots at the Execution of Manipulation Operations
abstract: The paper considers a new approach to the joint control of two mobile robots. Both are equipped with vision systems, and one of them also with a multi-link manipulator. The created control system provides automatic execution of manipulation operations with various objects when the work object is out of the visibility zone of the mobile robot with manipulator. In this case the position of this object is determined by the vision system of the auxiliary robot.

articleTitle: Project of Automated System's Information Security System Selection
abstract: Automation of production processes of enterprise today has enormous scales. The spread of automated control systems of technological processes (ACSTP) and their integration with corporate information systems have led to increase in proportion of successfully implemented malicious impacts on ACSTP. Occurrence of new types of attacks and increase in number of successfully implemented attacks cause the need to form protection systems of industrial systems. Designing protection system of ACSTP is multi-stage process, starting with collection of data on object of protection, its main components, information assets, links with other systems, and identification of relevant information security threats to the system. In this article analysis of structure of typical automated control system of technological process is carried out. The most important components of ACSTP from the point of view of information security are identified. The article defines the need to form project of protection system of ACSTP on the basis of monitoring data of events that occur in ACSTP. Main classes of system events from the point of view of information security are defined. The most typical information security threats for this type of automated systems are considered. Neutralization of groups of threats relevant to ACSTP is carried out by means of forming effective protection system. The typical composition of data protection system of ACSTP is defined. According to results of analysis, the correspondence between security events of ACSTP, current threat groups and typical means of information protection is determined. Choosing the composition of information security tools is complex task that requires a lot of time. To achieve greater efficiency in its solving, it is proposed to use decision support system and system of artificial intelligence. Authors developed functional model of selection of protection system's project using intelligent method of decision support with neural network in it.

Author Keywords: methods of intellectual support of decision-making

articleTitle: Automated Control System for Parallel Operation of Five Generator Sets in the Electric Power System
abstract: In this article, descript realization of the parallel operation of generator sets between each other and the grid, its basic principles, rules, technical solutions. The system of parallel operation of five diesel generators of the one power is described.

articleTitle: Innovative Energy Producing Structures in Russia
abstract: The future of energy depends directly on the direction and pace of technological development. The article is based on the analysis of priority areas of technological development and strategic orientations of Russia's main trading partners and competitors in the energy sector in order to assess the prospects for further cooperation. An analysis of the technology benchmarks shows that the priority areas - energy efficiency and renewable energy sources in general do not depend on the strength of countries with traditional energy resources. The differences in the perspective directions of development of energy technologies of Russia and partner countries are determined. It is proved that in recent years, the so-called. “New energy” has become one of the key national priorities of developed and developing countries, which led to huge investments in infrastructure, production, support of demand in order to ensure rapid growth of the relevant markets. At the same time, the main focus is on renewable energy sources, “new transport” and “smart networks”, which act as technologies capable of providing an energy revolution and a new cycle of sustainable economic growth. The work defines serious limitations in the development of the energy sector and energy technologies: not the optimal policy for supporting technology, unfavorable development conditions and high expectations. It is proved that the development of the “new energy” remains a significant task, including. since it reflects the objective need for technological renovation of the industry, reinforces the intersectoral potential of scientific and technological development and serves as a “testing ground” for developing new management tools for innovation processes.

articleTitle: Combined Modeling of Fire and Evacuation from Premises
abstract: A combined mathematical model is proposed, which includes a model of the fire, heat and smoke spread and a model of people evacuation from the premises. The combined model is focusing on dangerous influence of smoke on the people movement and behavior in the evacuation process. Results of modeling obtained on the basis of the model use are presented.

articleTitle: Mathematical Modeling of Blood Flow in a Patientspecific Model of the Middle Cerebral Artery Taking into Account Non-Newtonian Blood Behavior
abstract: According to recent studies hemodynamic conditions play an important role in initiation and development of several disorders of the cerebral circulation, such as atherosclerosis and aneurysm. One of the common sites of the aneurysm formation is the middle cerebral artery (MCA). In the present study, the flow conditions in the individualized model of the MCA aneurysm are investigated in detail and correlated with the aneurysm genesis. A patient-specific model of the saccular aneurysm of MCA was derived from the real clinical imaging data. A realistic physiological pulse curve was scaled to ensure the normal inlet flow rate in the artery. A transient computational fluid dynamics simulation was performed employing the Local viscosity fluid model, which takes into account non-Newtonian blood behavior and increases a precision of hemodynamic parameters evaluation, especially at low shear rate zones. The complex flow pattern was observed in the aneurysm sac, producing a swirling blood flow. A flow impingement zone near the aneurysm fundus was characterized by the high velocity values, about 0.9 m/s, which could potentially affect the endothelial cells at this zone and contribute to further arterial wall degeneration. Moreover, the zone of low wall shear stresses (<2 Pa) was observed on the aneurysm dome, producing conditions for further growth of the aneurysm. The results of the study are consistent with hemodynamic theory of aneurysm genesis and correlate well with available clinical data. CFD simulation could be used as an additional tool for clinical decision support during the treatment of the cerebral aneurysms.

articleTitle: Long-Term Changes in Conditions for the Development of Conventional Thermal and Non-Carbon Energy Technologies in the Power System of the Far East
abstract: The article examines the results of a study of the competitiveness of new gas, coal, nuclear, wind and solar power plants for their development in the electric power system of the Far East of Russia in modern conditions and until 2030. Taking into account the forecasts of capital costs and fuel prices by the criteria of levelized cost of electricity (LCOE), the changes in the economic conditions for the emergence of non-carbon power plants in the power system of the Far East are estimated. It is pointed that cheapening of these technologies should be supported by a reduction of the cost of capital to improve economic opportunities for their development in competition with the thermal generation in terms of LCOE analysis. In addition to this, supplemental costs related with the integration of renewable generation sources into power system are also investigated as a negative factor for their expansion. Competitive positions of power plants in the electric power system of the Far East as sources of electric power export to the Asia-Pacific countries were also studied using the actual cost and performance data as well as the forecasts of local fuel prices in China and Japan.

articleTitle: Modified Method Approximation of Empirical Dependency
abstract: The article presents a practical problem that arises in a number of applied areas in the approximation of experimental data using the least squares method. In a number of engineering applications there is a need to present these data in the form of empirical formulas of power, exponential and other types, to present the desired dependence in the form of a polynomial. In this case, use the alignment of the original variables. After the transition to the main variables, the proximity of the experimental points to the empirical polynomial does not determine this proximity in the final relation. The paper presents an amendment that ensures this proximity, provides specific types of empirical formulas for which the corresponding systems of corrected normal equations are obtained. The considered example of application of the refined technique leads to a more accurate approximation of empirical dependence.

articleTitle: Optimization of a Single-Stage Heat Pump Operation Through Subcooling and Superheating
abstract: The article describes the optimization of a single-stage heat pump operation through subcooling and superheating. The method of heat pump calculation determining the optimal temperature at which begins subcooling and superheating is considered. The mathematical model of calculation of the heat pump operation at various parameters of coolant and refrigerant is developed and analyzed. According to the results of the calculations, the tables of coolant point functions and graph of a single-stage heat pump operation with subcooling and superheating in t-Q diagram are built. Based on the optimization results, the conclusions on energy efficiency and coefficient of performance (COP) for each heat pump system are drawn.

Author Keywords: mathematical model of a heat pump

articleTitle: Computer Analysis of Brand Functioning in Tyumen Region
abstract: The following article is devoted to linguistic computer diagnostics of the Mitsubishi car. The aspect of the offered research lies in the field of engineering and cognitive linguistics. The aim of the following article is track life cycle of the Mitsubishi car brand because the tools of computer statistics and visualization help not only to process numerical data, but also to predict and to diagnose them. We try to understand the right pronunciation for Tyumen people.

articleTitle: Investigation of the Algorithm for Determining the Acoustic Signals Sources Angular Coordinate
abstract: The results of the investigation of the algorithm for measuring the angular position of two sources of an acoustic field are presented. The case is considered when the sources are within the width of the main lobe of the receiving antenna of directivity characteristic. The possibility of applying an algorithm for estimating the angular position for sources of both coherent and incoherent signals is shown. With a decrease in the angular distance between the radiation sources and with a decrease in the signal-to-noise ratio, a shift in the estimates of their angular coordinates may occur. This is caused by the non-linearity of signal conversion in the algorithm. To reduce the magnitude of the angle estimation offset, and also to reduce the mean square errors of the measured parameters, it is possible to average the control signal in the feedback loop. The studies confirmed the conclusion that the instrumental errors of the antenna and the receiving channels exert a significant influence on the magnitude of the displacement of the angular position estimates. The applied algorithm corrects such errors. The correction method is based on the joint determination of the source angular coordinates and instrumental errors. Estimation of additional parameters leads to a certain decrease in accuracy when measuring the coordinates of radiation sources. However, for small meter errors this decrease in accuracy is insignificant.

articleTitle: Estimation of the Realization of Traction Force on the Adhesion of AC Electric Locomotives with an Asynchronous and Collector Drives
abstract: The article is devoted to the analysis of traction and power tests materials of 2ACS and 2AC7, new alternating current electric locomotives with an asynchronous drive, which claim that such electric locomotives have advantages over 3ACS, a domestic three-section electric locomotive with a collector drive. Merits and demerits of hard traction characteristics of the asynchronous drive as compared to soft traction characteristics of the collector drive on realization of traction force at the limit of adhesion and fast adhesion recovery after slipping emergence are assessed. The conclusion is drawn about impossibility of sustained locomotive operation at the limit of adhesion although locomotive operating mode regards slipping as operating traction mode. The impossibility is proved by statistics of malfunctions of traction motors.

articleTitle: Modern Methods of Investigation of Heat Transfer Enhancement in Shell-and-Tube Heat Exchangers
abstract: The article is devoted to the applying of heat supply systems in Russia. It is necessary for creation of comfortable working and recreational conditions. Special attention is paid to the heat-exchange devices which are used for the various types of heat supply systems. It is revealed that shell-and-tube heat exchangers are the most widespread. The emphasis is placed on increase in productivity of such devices by turbulization of liquid at the heat-exchange surface. Basic researches on increase in flow turbulization at the flat firm surface are considered. It leads to the increase in heat emission from the firm surface to the liquid. Application of a program complex for a liquid stream hydrodynamics research is presented.

articleTitle: Selecting Power Transformers Based on Magnetic Path Parameters
abstract: Present State of the Issue Considered: The authors considered the indicators, which qualitatively characterize the parameters and the magnetized inrush current value of the transformer's magnetic core and the induced transition processes in the high voltage electric main. Materials and methods: The indicators, evaluating the losses of energy of the magnetizing inrush current aperiodic component stored in the magnetic path inductance at transition processes; identification of magnetizing path parameters in a power transformer. The authors studied the following indicators: the tangent of the angle <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\delta-$</tex> describes the loss of energy in the active resistance of the magnetic path, merit factor Q - shows how many times the path reactive resistance exceeds the active one. Results: The indicators allow for the qualitatively assessment and comparison of transformers in terms of the minimal impact of the magnetizing inrush current aperiodic component on the electric system and setting the necessary properties to the manufacturer during the transformer manufacture. Conclusions: The indicators provide a quantitative and qualitative assessment of the duration and nature of the decay of the transition process in the electric main.

Author Keywords: loss angle tangent in the path

articleTitle: Energy Efficiency in Forestry Machinery
abstract: In Russia in forestry, hunting and fishery industry expended about 5% of all energy using in country. The majority of this energy consumed in agricultural and forestry machinery is in the form of driving force in machinery and equipment. The purpose of the present study is to discuss the scientific problems energy efficiency in forestry technological machines. The article presents the results of a study on the effect of dynamic parameters on energy conservation process in the forestry machines. Energy saving problem is solved using the method of dynamic analysis and synthesis of technical systems. The rationale energy-efficient parameters of transitional regime are described. Dynamic models of the motor and working process are simulated using their mechanical characteristics. Power balance equation in nonlinear dynamic system is compiled and solved analytically. Non-linearity in the technical system is associated with a time delay on energy flow parameters change. Due to this fact, the equation of mechanical energy balance has two solutions. In the first one, the transient's regimes, the angular velocity are increasing exponentially. In a second one embodiment the angular velocity is changing periodically. With time delay increasing, starting time of the technological machine is also increasing. With the exponential law of angular speed increasing, the machine startup time is less than of periodic law. Therefore, the first embodiment of the start machine is preferred.

articleTitle: Gradient Thermogramms in Practical Tasks Solution
abstract: The present work is devoted to obtaining gradient thermograms on liquid crystals of a cholesteric type. The technique and procedure of thermoindicators application, the ways of thermal streams reprsentation in practical devices are described. The technique for thermal pattern visualization in mechanics, heating engineering, hydraulics, optics, radio engineering, etc. is selected on the basis of the heat flow nature. Thus, the obtained gradient thermogram allows to read both qualitative and quantitative data taking into account the liquid crystals type, their mesophase, substrate, displacement temperature, if any. The theme is revealed through practical tasks such as the determination of electromagnetic wave length in the resonator, the determination of the friction coefficient of a pair of metals in the dry and liquid friction mode, thermal flows in the crystallizer modeling, material cutting modes during detail machining, corona discharge and tool cutting properties estimation. Liquid crystals are organic substances and they are subject to oxidation processes, which limits the application term of the liquid crystal thermoindicator, so to prolong the period of use one of the ways of encapsulating them, which allows to prolong the performance and efficiency term of the liquid crystal detector as a whole is proposed.

articleTitle: Automatic Evaluation of the Gas Flow Rate from Wells Using a Header-Flowline Gas Gathering System
abstract: When operating a gas well, the main issue is controlling the pressure in the well and reaching a certain operating flow rate, the so-called practical productivity of the well at which it is operated optimally. For operational control of the flow rate, one has to control the gas flow velocity through the flowline in real time. This paper proposes using an artificial pressure wave propagating in the gas flow at the speed of sound. Such a wave is generated when adding a hydrate inhibitor to the gas flow after which it propagates to both sides of the generation point. By measuring the time it takes the wave to travel a certain distance upstream and downstream, one can calculate the gas velocity. The automated system uses a two-cycle measurement. First, it finds the current baseline speed of sound in the common header, after which it finds the desired gas velocity at the wellhead where the flowline is connected to the common header. Pressure waves are registered by high-rate pressure sensors. The system uses a wireless data channel. Measurement accuracy is sufficient to find the well status and gas velocity in real time.

articleTitle: The Introduction of E-Learning Technologies Using Agile Software Development Methodology
abstract: The article analyzes the methodologies for implementing information systems in order to select the appropriate system for the created conditions of the project implementation: the introduction of e-learning technologies that imply a complex multifunctional e-learning system with the help of a small team and short implementation terms. The result of the analysis of methodologies for the implementation of information systems showed that none of the reviewed methodologies is suitable for the presented features of the project. Therefore, it was suggested to use Agile software development and IT projects managing Serum framework as a methodology for implementing information systems. For this purpose, the Agile software development was modified in accordance with the specifics of the implementing information systems methodologies. The process of implementing the e-learning system basing on Agile software development was described on the example of the implementation project done. The customer of the project has been Vladivostok Branch of the Russian Customs Academy.

articleTitle: Assessment of Energy Efficiency and Reliability of Heat Networks of Blagoveshchensk, Amur Region
abstract: The article identifies the main problems of transportation of thermal energy. The analysis of the state of the heat networks of the city of Blagoveshchensk of the Amur region. The main problems of energy efficiency and reliability assessment of heat networks for planning and development of measures to improve the reliability of heat supply and solutions are identified. As a proposal to address these issues, this article proposes the introduction of an automated system of accounting for the state of the network in real time.

Author Keywords: energy efficiency of the heat supply system
coolant pressure in the heat network

articleTitle: Prospects of Transition to the Use of Decentralized Trigeneration in Tyumen Region
abstract: The article encompasses the issues of power supply efficiency increase when implementing own sources of energy generation with regard to prospects of modernization of the economic situation in the country. There have been done research and the integrated assessment of the efficiency of the use of own generation sources for the purpose of power supply of enterprises situated on the territory of Tyumen region in the context of ambiguous interrelations of the economy, power engineering and development of territories. In connection with the own generation increase, restrictions for the introduction of foreign equipment and the development of import substitution, there has emerged an urgent problem of applying modern power supply schemes. The article gives a review of the methodical approach based on the overall assessment of territorial and economic development of the areas. The assessment involves considering the requested level of regularity and mobility of installations as well as conditions of connection to the centralized energy source.
