Besides, it is necessary to analyze technical and economic characteristics of the existing units. The researcher formulated and put in order the criteria that allow comparing and estimating energy parks with heating and trigeneration cycles on the most balanced basis. There is represented a technique of determining the effectiveness of autonomous power supply sources of an industrial enterprise with the use of modern energy-saving schemes based on a new generation of refrigerating machines. The results of the carried out technical and economic analysis allow simplifying economic assessment and the choice of the best technologies of energy supply.

articleTitle: Ensuring the Accelerated Development of the Russian Energy Sector on the Basis of a Technological Transfer Through Economic and Mathematical Modeling Tools
abstract: Based on the analysis of the problems of interrelation of innovative processes in the national economy with sectoral development in the framework of specific technological structures, the conceptual model of the mechanism of accelerated development of the industry has been developed and justified, which allows to prove that technology transfer is an indispensable tool for project management, optimally corresponding to the task of accelerated development. Based on the analysis of existing methods for assessing the innovation potential of economic systems, it is revealed that the development of a system of indicators for the analysis of innovation potential is a complex and unresolved problem to date, while a common lack of the evaluation methods used is the lack of a systematic approach to the choice of evaluation indicators. It is substantiated that the assessment of innovative potential should consist in obtaining private indicators with further reduction to a generalized indicator, which is expedient to use, the criterion of maximum efficiency of using innovative potential.

articleTitle: Organizational and Economic Conditions for Ensuring the Accelerated Development of the Russian Energy Sector on the Basis of Industrial Technology Platforms
abstract: Based on the analysis of priority regulatory and legal acts in the field of Russia's long-term economic development, the features of building innovative sectoral technology platforms in the energy sector that are traditionally key to the state's economy are revealed, which is the plane in which it is necessary to build effective partnerships between industrial enterprises, the research and educational sector, and the state in the field of joint advanced development. Based on the experience of the formation and development of energy innovation structures abroad and the comparative analysis of Russian energy structures taking into account the goals and objectives of innovative development, the prospects for creating an intersectoral technology platform with the participation of enterprises and organizations of the energy industry are determined, the need for its construction is determined, and its structure is proposed. The formation of the proposed interbranch technological platform can become an important infrastructure element of the programs of strategic development of the branch and regional economy based on the development of the real production sector.

articleTitle: Choose of Strategy of TPP Modernization with the Application of System Analysis Methods and Non-Linear Optimization
abstract: When modernizing the thermal power plants (TPP), environmental, economic, technical, risky and other criteria should be taken into account. The modernization can bother one or several subsystems of TPP. When using the Saaty's analytic hierarchy process, it's possible to choose the optimal strategy of modernization of the energy production facility by multiple criteria. The decision maker's (DM) subjectivism is one of cons of some methods of choose when estimation of criteria priorities for alternative projects is being performed. In this paper, the choose of modernization strategy of Novocherkassk GRES is performed using the Saaty's method. At the final stage, the methods of linear and non-linear optimization are applied to decrease the impact of DM's subjectivism. The fact that the implementation of the radical changes in more than two TPP subsystems in one project is not expedient is demonstrated. The modernization of the whole plant should be carried out in several steps).

articleTitle: Use of Computer Technologies in the Railway Infrastructure Elements Modeling and Train Traffic Control Systems Simulator Development
abstract: Railway traffic control is a complex multilevel system, research, and enhancement of which could make use of mathematical modeling. Simulation of infrastructural elements is a set of methods used in railway section design, traffic modeling, tools functionality modeling, and simulating the process safety systems. The basic concept of designing the infrastructural elements is based on creating a multilayer linked data structure generated based on AutoCAD layers. Preparing the input data for simulation implies describing the aspects of a constructed world, i.e., generating a railway section, placing the switches and signals, installing control and safety systems. The topological map of a railroad can be described by linear differential equations, which means we could use mathematics to build the plan and profile of the track elements as well as to calculate the position of moving units in a simulated space. Due to the high computational complexity of using high-degree polynomials for the approximation of railway sections, we propose partitioning complex curves into cubic splines. Practical use of this method proves it efficient for both designing a virtual railway section and for programming a functional model. Simulation of control systems is based on specially developed algorithms that use recursive problem-solving methods; coupled with a modular architecture, this feature enables the model to self-organize. Based on computer simulations, we have created an SW/HW simulator to be used for the training and retraining of railway personnel. Multilayer data structuring, modularity, hierarchical structure and openness of the architecture also enable using this development to generate objective models for various kinds of applied research.

articleTitle: Solution of the Task of Managing IT-Services with the Focus on the Business Processes of an Industrial Enterprise
abstract: The article presents one of the possible solutions to the problem of IT-management in an industrial enterprise. The IT-department of an industrial enterprise is seen as the provider of IT-services for business, which should bring profit. The solution of the problem is proposed through the introduction of business-oriented IT-management based on the BSM (Business Service Management) concept using the Routes To Value methodology. This methodology assumes the phased implementation of BSM in accordance with the level of criticality. The article considers an important direction in the process of managing IT-services in an industrial enterprise, namely, Service Level Management. Approbation of the results of the research was carried out through the implementation of the TrackStudio Enterprise user support system in the IT-department of the industrial enterprise.

articleTitle: Audio Signal Transmission Over Low-Speed Communication Channels for Emergency Broadcast
abstract: Real-time audio signal processing is a particularly difficult task. It is requiring significant computing resources of signal processing tools, as well as a special approach to writing software. This article demonstrates a block diagram of the device and describes algorithm, which realize a recording of a signal, speech recognition process, compressing, coding and transmitting. LabView15 is used as the development environment, and myRIO-1900 with FPGA is used to develop the device. The Python programming language is used to implement the algorithm for detecting speech in a noisy signal. A method based on the formant theory of intelligibility was used as a method of recognizing a speech signal. The device allows to perform real-time analysis of the operation of signal processing algorithms.

articleTitle: Applying Autonomous Electric Fueling on Solid Oxide Fuel Cells to Improve the Energy Efficiency of Mining Operations
abstract: At present, an urgent issue is the reduction of energy consumption during work in mines. The paper presents investigate the possible reduction of energy and economic costs when replacing diesel loaders used in mining on electrical analogs and introducing a self-contained power plant based on solid oxide fuel cells as a source of current for charging. The using electric drive loaders would result in a reduction of ventilation costs by 162,000 rub/year. Charging vehicles from the power plant on solid oxide fuel cells can save amount to 215 thousand rubles in a year.

articleTitle: Development and Research Self-Organizing Network Based on Protocol IEEE 802.11 Wi-Fi
abstract: The article describes how to organize a channel for data transfer using the IEEE 802.11 Wi-Fi standard defined by the mesh topology. As the end nodes of the network, fairly common modules based on the ESP8266EX microprocessor are used, which differ from their competitors not only by the ease of downloading the program code and further use, but also at a relatively affordable price. Theoretical, practical indicators of communication range, the question of the security of the self-organizing network obtained and possible applications are analyzed. Theoretical calculations of the communication range were confirmed experimentally, showing an excellent result in the percentage of received packets. The results obtained completely satisfy the definition of the topology used. Based on the definition of the 802.11s standard, an increase in the network when connecting points can occur at any time, which increases the distance between the sender and the receiver. Development can be used to exchange messages in narrowly specialized industries, educational purposes, and also apply universally.

articleTitle: Analysis and Information System in the Indicative Assessment of the Level of Energy Security of the Northem and Arctic Regions
abstract: Negative northern factors with a complex impact of the natural environment on the conditions of life and production are so significant that they put forward a monitoring of the energy security of the regions belonging to the Northern Territories and the Arctic zones to an important position. Specificity of the composition of threats has an aggravating effect in conditions of infrastructure isolation and climate severity for the functioning of the energy economy and the livelihoods of settlements. At present, there is no single approach, both to defining indicators of such territories, and to the toolkit for their tracking and identification of decentralized conditions. The research has developed an information and analytical system that allows in the integrated environment to calculate current indicators indicators. The author's methodology for assessing weak and vulnerable places defines priority areas with stringent requirements for providing comfortable living conditions for electricity consumers. This increases the speed of problem analysis in isolated areas of the North with low reliability indicators. The developed analytical unit, as a component of an integrated information system for monitoring the level of energy security, provides an opportunity to update the initial data of indicators and calculate their effective values for the formation of a strategic platform for targeted strengthening of energy security positions. The model and toolkit for diagnosing decentralized territories are examined on the example of the zone of absolute discomfort - the Republic of Sakha (Yakutia), as the leader of large-scale exploitation of small-scale power engineering objects.

articleTitle: Search for Substrings in Associative Decision Fields
abstract: The article was devoted to the prerequisites of the use of computational SIMD structures of the associative memory type for organizing work with data string, in particular for finding occurrences of the search substring in a long string such as a string of the genetic code. The input structures of the line and orthogonal data input are proposed. The procedures for finding the entries for different ratios of the lengths of the genetic string, the occurrence substring, the size of the associative field, and the conditions for data entry are developed.

articleTitle: Peculiarities of Application of Helioenergetics for Signaling, Interlocking and Blocking Devices at the Railroad Transport
abstract: The article reviews the problem of replacement of energy supply sources at the railroad transport, in particular the sources used to feed signaling, centralizing and interlocking (SIB) devices, from generators operating on DGA type diesel fuel, to renewable energy sources, in particular to solar photovoltaics stations (SPVS) of small and medium capacity. No such research was done at the railroad transport so far. With the purpose of improving the ecological situation and reducing the diesel fuel use, it is necessary to switch to helioenergetics, since it is ecologically sound, plus the insolation level in the Russian Far East is quite high (4% less than in the city of Sochi). To commence these researches we will be limited so far to solar photovoltaics plants (SPVP) of small capacity that are capable of serving several spans of a railroad track. It is necessary though to take into account regional peculiarities of a railroad track while calculating SPVP. First of all it's relatively long extension of tracks as well as severe climate conditions. In the article it is proposed to use SPVP of up to 1,500 W capacity. Such SPVP is suitable for two “Ohmiks” of 630 W and 1,250 W, respectively. Economic evaluation of the cost of 1 kWh per 1 year and for ten years for those two “Ohmiks” was done. Data concerning the term of energy payback for a SPVP is provided.

articleTitle: Synthesis of Structure of Actuating Link Group with Common Drive Based on Formation and Analysis of Scheme of Functioning
abstract: Anthropomorphic gripper (AG) is designed by analogy with a human hand and contains five actuating link groups (ALG), four of which are similar. Sequential motion of hand finger phalanges: proximal, mesial, distal is realized during the object grasping. Thus its rotation is performed around parallel rotation axes. Significant weight determined by the number of motors corresponding to the number of degrees of freedom is one of the most essential problems of AG designing. To reduce the number of motors the motion of output ALG links should be performed from common drive. Synthesis of structural scheme of motion transmission system (MTS) that realizes the common drive is performed on the basis of preliminary formation of scheme of functioning. Its formation is accomplished by providing of required motion process of output links during interaction with external object surface. Necessary component elements defining processes in MTS completely are determined. Its graphical interpretation is proposed. Set of MTS each of which provides interaction with external objects by analogy with finger grasping is designed through the identification of component elements of scheme of functioning and structural scheme. Its usage allows to reduce the necessary number of used motors from 20 to 10 saving gripper functionality.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Current State and Prospects for Alternative Energy in the Northern Regions (Russia)
abstract: Alternative energy is part of an energy producing system that uses renewable energy sources. Approximately 1% of the electricity in the world today is produced by solar power and slightly more than 2% by windmills. Use of installed capacity of solar and wind energy is being doubled every four years. In Europe trend of the new energy industry is already downward. China plans to actually produce “green” energy in the amount of 250 gigawatts by year 2040. In the US there are plans to receive 5-6.4% of electricity from solar radiation by the year 2040. In Russia alternative energy sector will also grow, but not so quickly due to the rich underground resources that allows long and efficient use of traditional energy sources.

articleTitle: Measurement of Objective Functions Influence on Vehicle Routing Problems Solution
abstract: The vehicle routing problem is a well-known and attractive line in the optimization research community. This article discusses a multi-criteria version of the problem that is most often associated with distributed transportation of goods and, as practice shows, the real optimality of its solution actually depends on a large number of criteria, the significance of which varies greatly. Regardless of the solution method used, accounting for each criterion requires additional computational resources and some insignificant factors in this connection need to be excluded from consideration. However, it is difficult to measure in advance the extent of influence of the factors on the decision, i.e. their significance. For this reason, the analysis of criteria influence on the vehicle routing problem solution has been carried out.

articleTitle: Simulator of Carbon Nanotubes Manufacturing
abstract: The article is concerned with the development of Simulator of Carbon Nanotubes Manufacturing. Simulator of work with carbon nanotubes concentrator allows training specialists in nanotechnology. Simulator completely prototypes (models) the Carbon Nanotubes Manufacturing. Simulator is developed in Unity 3D environment. The article contains the description of Unity 3D environment. Operating procedure of simulator consists of 14 stages. At every stage the user inserts or chooses the right answer, sets the mixing parameters. Simulator prototypes (models) compound components mixing process and tests manufactured Carbon Nanotubes. The article describes all stages of Carbon Nanotubes Manufacturing. Figures show work stages of simulator in Google Chrom Browser. Simulator successfully passes all stages of testing. At this time it is introduced into electronic teaching programs eNano.

articleTitle: Methods of the Signal Processing for Sound Field Visualization
abstract: The paper deals with the features of the processing of acoustic signals generated by an underwater low-frequency radiator in shallow sea. Data from four channels of a combined hydroacoustic receiver is processed to identify a signal against noise and build 3D sonograms of the sound field. Linear and nonlinear processing algorithms were applied to separate the useful signal. Comparison of the sonograms shows the advantage of the nonlinear algorithm which completely eliminates the fluctuation component of the noise interference and provides a better visual detection of the signal component.

articleTitle: The Protection Method for Telecommunication Networks from the Computer Intelligence
abstract: The authors of the article suggest the method that allows to ensure increase of security of the information and telecommunication network and the object of the critically important infrastructure as a whole.

articleTitle: Design of Control System for Canned Electromechanical Converter
abstract: The canned induction motor automatic control system consisting of two control channels, i.e. the rotor flux linkage and speed, has been designed. The experimental results were obtained using Matlab Simulink packages. The modeling object is a canned induction motor with 1.1 kW square-cage rotor. The research focuses on the processes occurring in the canned induction motor as a controlled object within the electric engineering installation. On the basis of the results obtained, a block diagram of the control system is proposed that compensates for the effect of the can and satisfies the requirements for control performance.

articleTitle: Revisiting the Choice of GIS Software to Implement Educational Programs at University
abstract: The article analyzes the issue of choosing geoinformation systems (GIS) software to implement essential professional educational programs at university. As a basis for the choice, the sufficiency of software characteristics to develop professional expertise in the scope of geoinformation systems in graduates has been adopted. The following choice procedure has been offered: 1) specification of the requirements to graduates' professional expertise based on the analysis of the Federal State Education Standards (FSES), professional standards and requirements of potential employers; 2) analysis of the GIS software characteristics in terms of possibility to implement the requirements to expertise; 3) establishment of compliance between the requirements to expertise and software characteristics and the software options on offer; 4) the choice of the software. The procedure has been tested during the implementation of essential professional educational programs in the scope of Geology, Information Systems and Technologies, and Applied Geodesy in the Institute of Geology and Petroleum Engineering of Industrial University of Tyumen. A conclusion about the viability of joint use of proprietary and open-source software in educational process has been made. The proposed approach to the choice can be extended to applied information technologies of any thematic focus.

articleTitle: Stability of Interacting Counter-Swirling Gas Jets in the Furnaces of Fire-Tube Hot-Water
abstract: Simulation of the velocity field of two counter-rotating horizontally rotating jets with precessing vortex cores showed that the velocity in the cross-section at the jets of jet jets changes like a single jet to the middle, and then corresponds to the velocity profile in the interaction of counter-rotating streams, while the velocity field is stratified according to the magnitude of the displacement, which is explained by the change in the region of interaction of the jets. It is revealed that the evolution of the velocity peak caused by the addition of the velocities of interacting jets determines the optimal ratio between the displacement of jets in the horizontal plane and the distance between the points of their outflow equal to 0.25.

articleTitle: Heat Supply System in the Areas Remote from the Centralized Source: The Case of Tyumen
abstract: The article is devoted to the description of a heat supply system in Tyumen and problem areas located outside the radius of effective operation of existing heating plants. The heat supply system using heat pumps is proposed (the main pipeline for transferring low potential heat is supposed to be laid from a thermal power station as a turbine cooling system which dumps waste into the river Tura at present), and indicators of its economic efficiency have been calculated. The proposed solution was compared with other variants of heat supply in the areas in question (preservation of existing CHP zones, reconstruction of heating systems and laying new pipelines and pumping stations; the construction of a third source - a gas turbine thermal power plant in the north-western part of the city; construction of the western thermal complex in the circuit of a thermal power plant).

articleTitle: An Algorithm for Choosing a Method of Software Acquisition
abstract: This research involves the development of an algorithm for choosing the optimal method of software acquisition for a company. Evaluation of the economic efficiency of two alternative ways to purchase software are presented in the article: the purchase of a licensed version of software vs. rental of SaaS (Software as a Service) based software. The algorithm allows for comparison of alternatives, taking into account the availability of information and the level of informativety of methods, and can be successfully applied in enterprises planning to invest in IT.

articleTitle: Developing X-Ray Simulator for Luggage Screening
abstract: The article is concerned with the development of computer simulator complex for supporting teaching and practical application of X-ray equipment for luggage screening. The paper offers algorithms of image processing for imitating the work of a high quality simulator, as well as two new methods of processing images imitating deep penetration and exposure of materials. The results of the study are to be implemented in teaching students.

articleTitle: Characteristic Trajectories Detection in Spatio-Temporal Data Streams
abstract: This article represents the approach for solving task of identifying objects' frequent migration trajectories. This task may take place in the study of migration trajectories of birds, animals; in the study of the trajectories of an object or a group of objects during a period of time. The described method is oriented to processing of spatio-temporal data streams. Two stages for identifying characteristic trajectories are considered. The first step is to solve the clustering problem for the analyzed data. The second stage is identifying the most frequently encountered sets of clusters. The time period of information to be processed should be chosen. Ways and algorithms to solve these tasks are offered which take into consideration requirements for speed and quality of problem solving.

articleTitle: New Technologies in Automation of Information and Analytical Activity in the Business Processes of Oil and Gas Enterprise
abstract: The object of research is the process of accounting for material assets at enterprises of the oil and gas sector using radio frequency identification technology (RFID). Quality control of objects when they move through the supply chain. It presents technical characteristics of existing RFID systems, a guideline for RFID deployment, and some applications in Supply chains.

articleTitle: Plasma Technology for the Incineration of Solid Domestic Waste and the Destruction of Toxic Emissions
abstract: This article is devoted to the problem of solid domestic waste disposal. Since most of the SDW is stored in landfills and rubbish dumps, this inevitably leads to the alienation of large areas. Moreover landfills are often sources of secondary pollution of the environment: conditions are created at waste storage sites that contribute to the spread of infections and the occurrence of fires. In connection with the foregoing, the solution of the problem of waste treatment has become of primary importance in recent years. The article analyzes of known methods of SDW processing, special attention is paid to plasma technology based on the use of a plasma chemical reactor and a low-temperature plasma generator - a plasmatron. The mobile unit will partially solve the environmental problem in places of mass recreation. In a stationary version, the unit can be used for generating heat and electric energy. Plasma technology can allow not only to completely dispose of dangerous wastes, but also to produce goods and services ready for consumption. In this way it will completely involve the waste in further production, which is the basic principle of rational nature management.

articleTitle: Prediction and Decision-Making Algorithms in System Monitoring of Forest Lands
abstract: The methods of forecasting are considered: expert estimates, analogies, extrapolations and analytical (models). The experts' poll is used when forecasting the use of forest plots on the lands of populated areas. The method of analogy is most widely used in the evaluation of medium-forming functions. The method based on extrapolation is widely used in the practice of forest management. These methods are “naive”. The forecast by models allows to “penetrate” the internal mechanism of ecosystems of forest lands, using established cause-effect relationships. The results of forecasting based on analytical models of annual runoff in forest-covered watersheds under different scenarios of forest management are presented. Algorithms of decision-making in the sphere of land relations on forest lands are considered; stages of forecasting: research, program and organizational.

articleTitle: Automatic Control of Operation of the Knife Grinding Machines
abstract: In paper the critical analysis ways of steering is lead by operation disc mills. Probe of transient factors of milling on vibration stator is lead. Correlation between gain of quality indicators of beating material and vibration stator is shown. New ways of steering by knife grinding machines on amplitude vibration stator and the account of other oblique parameters of operation mills are offered. The developed ways are irreplaceable at automatic control knife grinding machines with two zones mill. The offered ways have passed positive approbation at enterprise “Solikamskbumprom ”.

articleTitle: Justification of Requirements to Productivity of Wireless Network
abstract: The transition to digital technology and the introduction of automated methods for processing air data requires the production of an assessment of available network resources. The article provides a brief analysis of the existing regulatory framework on the requirements for information transmitted through digital communication channels for purposes of air traffic control and proposes an evaluation procedure for the performance of a wireless network for transmitting information on the air environment at civil and state airfields.

articleTitle: Energy Recovery by Reducing the Gas Pressure from the Main Pipeline to the Distribution Pipeline
abstract: The article considers the possibility of generating electrical energy in gas distribution stations, by using the potential energy of the pressure differential of natural gas, as a secondary energy source. A patent-information study was carried out. The object of the study is the energy recovery system in the gas transition from the main to the distribution pipeline. The subject of the study is to determine the dependence of the recovery efficiency on the magnitude of the pressure difference, the transported gas temperature, and also the distribution network gas flow in schemes with gas expansion-generator unit. To improve the energy efficiency of the gas reduction system, new schemes of plants for generating electricity, heat and cold have been proposed. As an optimization criterion, the recovery efficiency has been chosen. The research methodology, the scheme of the laboratory research stand, and the scheme of the measuring path are proposed. Due the lack of empirical data on the efficiency of gas pressure conversion in the reduction process, it is proposed to conduct a physical laboratory experiment by using full factorial experiment scheme.

articleTitle: Computer Simulation of the Driving Mode of the Logger Through an Obstacle
abstract: The paper presents a computer simulation model of the mode of movement of the logger through an obstacle, which includes a system of differential equations of the second order. The results of the study impact on the level of dynamic loads speed, height of the obstacle, the displacement of the center of gravity of the tree relative to the longitudinal axis of the crawler logger. A simulation model in Mathcad environment was created to conduct the research on the computer. The result is a machine experiment was found the magnitude of the dynamic loads that occur on the body of the logger and process equipment under the influence of disturbing factors, identified dynamic factors. Given the graphs of dynamic loads and dynamic factors from disturbing factors.

articleTitle: Research of Ways to Improve the Heating System of the City of Blagoveshchensk Amur Region
abstract: This article presents a study of the search for ways to improve and increase the energy efficiency of heat supply systems of the city of Blagoveshchensk, Amur region. The reform of housing and communal services of the country is connected with the introduction of energy-saving technologies, and with the problems of reconstruction of heating systems of residential areas, small financing of the industry, reducing the reliability and quality of the heat supply system as a whole. Due to the intensive growth of construction of residential complexes of the city, development of territories, a sharp rise in industry, the demand for thermal energy is steadily growing. The article analyzes the structure of the existing district heating system of the city of Blagoveshchensk and its features. The main problems of the heat supply system are determined. The assessment of energy saving potential in this industry on the example of the city of Blagoveshchensk of the Amur region is carried out and the optimal solutions for achieving a significant increase in energy efficiency of heat supply systems are determined.

articleTitle: Research of Processes of Education and Decomposition of Dioxine When Burning Waste by Traditional Fire Methods and in Low-Temperature Plasma
abstract: One of the most widespread ways of utilization of the municipal solid waste (MSW) is burning. When burning waste traditional methods form toxins in the form of dioxine, furan. Dioxine is the ekotoksikant possessing mutagen, immunodepressantny, cancerogenic action. Dioxine and furana are badly dissolved in water, are steady against high temperatures, long remain in the environment, are easily transported on food chains and slowly removed from organisms of living beings. Plasma processing is the most effective and environmentally friendly in comparison with other ways of burning of waste as the number of the emissions getting to the atmosphere decreases in tens of times. The offered technology is based on use of arc plasma (the plasma reactor and a plasmatron). The developed installation for combustion of MSW consists of two steps: The I step - melting and burning of waste (plastic, polymeric and organic materials, etc.); The II step - reburning of toxic gas emissions. At the same time harmful emissions in the atmosphere are excluded. Full decomposition of dioxine happens at temperatures above 1200°C, at smaller temperatures their repeated education is observed. In article the problem of formation of dioxine when burning waste is considered by traditional fire methods, and in low-temperature plasma. The plasma technology allows to get rid completely of dioxine thanks to high temperatures in the reactor of 1200-1600°C, and also at the second step at temperatures from 1600 to 2000 of OC. In article results of researches on decomposition of dioxine are given in low-temperature plasma on simple substances.

articleTitle: Complex Information Technology of Quality Control of an Asphalt - Concrete Covering of Highways
abstract: Complex information technology of quality control of asphalt - concrete mixture is considered starting from the asphalt - concrete plant (ACP), then at the stage and transportation as well as during laying in the highway. The implementation of this technology is carried out with the help of the GPS /GLONASS satellite system, which in real time mode allows you to capture the required parameters. Then these information are transferred to the integrated management system for the ACP. The structure of information support is presented and analyzed. This structure, takig into account the current situation and the process of packing and compacting the mixture, corrects the mode of operation of the plant equipment and ensures the production of an asphalt - concrete mixture of the required quality. The developed complex information technology of quality control of an asphalt - concrete with the use of GPS/GLONASS system provides to increase productivity and quality of the work performed, can reduce the influence of the human factor on the quality of the finished road surface, provides remote monitoring of main parameters of not only the technical means but also laying material, provides during non standard situation adjustment of system parameters PLANT - ROAD MACHINE - ASPHALT - concrete.

articleTitle: Modeling and Developing the Information System for a Programming Contest “Programmers' League”
abstract: The paper dwells on a web-based information system for various sports programming contests that allow assessing the participants' program code quality in programming languages (Java, C, C++, C#, Python). The designed system was used as a tool for programming contest “Programmers' league”. The experiment of the research the authors carried out at Sholom-Aleichem Priamursky State University. It ensured the advantage of developing and using a system of this kind, especially more flexible settings for contests, multi-stage leagues, implementing scoring systems, including bonus points for participants.

articleTitle: Consideration of Surface Relief to Model Electromagnetic Fields in Traction Networks
abstract: The research presented in the paper is aimed at developing methods and tools for adequate consideration of surface relief when modeling electromagnetic fields in traction power supply systems. To accomplish this goal, we applied the technologies for the determination of operating conditions of the traction power supply system in phase coordinates. The technologies are based on the models of components represented by lattice equivalent circuits with fully-connected topology. These models and methods are implemented in the Fazonord software that ensures modeling of the operation of traction power supply systems of various types and determination of strengths of electromagnetic field (EMF) created by traction networks of these systems. To calculate the EMF strengths of the surface irregularities represented by such structures as embankments, cuttings and slopes, they were simulated by sets of earthed wires located on the boundary of a structure. The distances between the wires were taken to be much shorter than the distances from these wires to the observation point. The paper presents the calculation results for electromagnetic fields in the traction networks constructed along the routes characterized by uneven relief. The research demonstrates that the proposed methods enable the implementation of an effective computer technology for modeling electromagnetic fields, that makes it possible to take into account the surface irregularities. The results of modeling the specific relief features indicate that the differences with respect to the model of a flat ground surface can reach 60 percent for electric field and 54 percent for magnetic field.

articleTitle: Methods of Increasing the Reliability of Solving the Problem of Diagnostics of Electrical Circuits
abstract: Methods for increasing the reliability of solving the problem of electrical circuits diagnostics. In the presence of inaccurate measurements and uncertainty of a priori information, the diagnostic model should be considered as a set of inconsistent linear equations and to seek the solution based on, for example, the method of least squares (MLS). The solution obtained satisfies the minimum of the sum of the squares of the residuals, but does not ensure the fulfillment of a number of other requirements entering into the initial system of the problem of electrical circuits diagnostics. And this requires adjusting the solution within the MLS. The present work is devoted to the adjustment issues. The algorithm based on the use of a correction factor in one component equation is proposed both for obtaining a solution that satisfies the active constraints, and for the exact implementation of the component relation.

articleTitle: Integrated Information System for the Assessment of Quality and Organizational Sustainability of the Mining Industry
abstract: The most competitive in the current global market remains products of extractive industries, which determines the increased attention to the problems of functioning of these industries and clarify the terms of their most sustainable development. Unique mineral-raw material complex of Russia can ensure the continued economic development of the state only on condition of effective activity of the largest mining enterprises. Important to adaptation of enterprises to the changing external environment that places new demands on planning, on the basis of the calculated predictive values, and creates the possibility of increasing the competitiveness of the organization. Integrated quality management system in the modern world represent the most important area of functioning and development of any production, great extent determine the competitiveness of the enterprise and prospects of its activities. The need for effective construction of a system of methods, tools, principles and tools of collection, analysis, evaluation, presentation and use of data evaluating the effectiveness and stability of functioning and directions of improving the organization of mining enterprise on the basis of the technical, economic, social and environmental issues in the framework of the technical and economic audit.

articleTitle: Improving Energy Efficiency and the Choice of Rational Parameters of the Boiler on the Example of the City of Blagoveshchensk Amur Region
abstract: The article deals with the main problems associated with the production and distribution of thermal energy. The analysis of the state of the boiler of the Amur region. The main problems related to the equipment of boiler houses and state regulation of thermal energy production are identified. As a solution to the identified problems, this article proposes a change in the heat supply system in order to improve its energy efficiency and resource saving.

articleTitle: Environmentally Friendly Method of Producing Electricity from Day-Night Temperature Swings
abstract: The article introduces a cheap method of producing electricity by using a temperature difference between day and night. The absolute ecological safety of such renewable energy source is proven. The article describes the conversion unit design, operation principle and cycles and addresses possible implementation issues is practice. The article gives recommendations for its use, including for space systems and colonization of Mars and other planets.

articleTitle: The Technique of the Estimation and the Control of the Permissible of the Degree of Bending of the Spine Based on the Neuromechanical Model
abstract: The paper proposes an information neuromechanical model of the human spine, taking into account physiological and mechanical features of the bone and nerve tissues of the patient's spine. The model allows estimating the probability of damage to nerve fibers during the movement. On the basis of an individual neuromechanical model of the patient, it becomes possible to assess the degree of flexion of the spine. Automatic control of the executive mechanisms of rehabilitation complexes occurs on the basis of the results of assessing the permissible degree of flexure of the spine and current positions in the space of segments of the spine. To record the movement of segments of the spine in space, it is proposed to use accelerometers and a phase control method.

articleTitle: Computer Technologies in Education
abstract: The paper dwells upon the research of main advantages and challenges dealing with the introduction of computer technologies in education. The foundations of ICT implementation in educational process are given according to the UNESCO regulatory framework. The arguments in favor of distance learning are given such as a quick and constant access, interactivity, use of audio-visual aids, wider scope of students involved, cost-efficiency. However, the paper also considers some problematic aspects of implementation of these technologies in the educational process. Firstly, that is the choice of the most efficient and rational niches of ICT implementation in education. Secondly, that is high cost of initial investment. However, we can conclude, that high requirements to the quality of education make ICT implementation in education necessary and expenses justified.

articleTitle: Editorial
abstract: International science and technology conference “EastConf” it is a subsection of a big conference the International Scientific Conference “FarEastCon” took place on October 2-4, 2018 in Vladivostok, Russian Federation.

articleTitle: Strategy for the Formation of Production Plans for Small-Serial Machine-Building Enterprises
abstract: Control of production in mechanical engineering is fulfilled on the basis of orders fulfilment plans. Creation of production plans for small-serial and single enterprises is NP a difficult task. The real production environment is a set of technological equipment, tool rigging and measuring facilities. Fulfilment of the production order comprises distribution of technological operations for each part and assembly unit product in the structure of the order. According to the authors, one of the main problems consists in disparity between the real production environment and models of plans creation production. For the solution of this problem in the article, approach of creation of the general corporative balanced plan is proposed, which is based on the use of a common information space and a single core of planning. When creating the information space for placing of a planning core, authors as the main priority considered production process, e.i. process of transformation of raw materials in a finished articles. Therefore the core of management is presented in the form of set of the functions placed in the center space of management with two measurements. The plan of any subdivision of the enterprise connected with production is formed in the form of projections of technological operations to the corresponding coordinates of a common corporative information space of planning. It provides balance and full synchronization of plans of subdivisions of the enterprise.)

articleTitle: Computational Modeling of the Atomizing of a Gas Stream from a Pneumatic Nozzle
abstract: Atomizing of liquid is widely used in modern technology. Atomizing occupies an extremely important place in power engineering, when burning liquid fuels. In this work provides verification of the method for modeling the atomizing of a gas-liquid stream from a pneumatic nozzle. Primary atomization is modelled using Large Eddy Simulation model (LES) and The Volume Of Fluid model (VOF). The results of the calculations show an acceptable agreement with experiment on the main characteristics of the spray. The results of calculations can be very useful for estimations, since they allow qualitatively correct determination of the structure of a two-phase flow, parameters and shape of droplets, and the speed and direction of their motion, which in principle can not be obtained by other methods.

articleTitle: Use of the Heat Accumulating Capability of the Enclosing Structures of a Building in Regulation of Heating Systems
abstract: The development and implementation of cost reduction methods for building heating systems can increase the comfort and reduce the operation costs on building maintenance during the heating period. One of the ways to increase efficiency is the development of regulation algorithms and their individual analysis in their application to each building. This paper presents a part of the experiment on the approbation of the developed algorithms for controlling a building's heating system.

articleTitle: E-Learning System of Knowledge Engineering for Design and Management of Sustainable Innovative Development of Regional Facilities
abstract: The article deals with the subject area of knowledge engineering in the design and management of sustainable innovative development, as well as tasks of the knowledge engineer in the field of sustainable development as researcher, designer and manager. The system of basic concepts, rules and principles of knowledge engineering in the design of sustainable development is considered. A system of natural-scientific parameters of sustainable innovative development is described, along with rules for their assessment, rules and tasks of sustainable development design and management in the system “nature - society - human”. The block of planning of sustainable innovative development through the functions of monitoring and evaluation of innovations is presented. An example of the structure and tasks of the system of design and management of sustainable development is given, as well as possibilities of its implementation as an e-Iearning system in the field of design and management of sustainable development. The work was supported by RFBR grant No. 12-06-00286-a.

articleTitle: Problems of Assessing Ignition Capability of Aluminum Particles in Electrical Wiring When a Short Circuit Occurs
abstract: Theoretical issues of ignition capability of aluminum particles that emerge in aluminum conductor electrical wiring at the occurrence of a short circuit are considered. The thermophysical model of combustion of large aluminum particles is refined. Experimental studies aimed to obtain analytical dependencies and numerical values of the parameters of incandescent and burning aluminum particles have been carried out. Time of particles' burning, their thermal energy, critical diameter of particles that may cause ignition of certain combustible materials, as well as the area of combustible materials most likely damaged by burning particles with due regard for remoteness of the short-circuit zone have been calculated.

articleTitle: Modeling of Distribution of Temperature at the Directed Giving of the Heat Carrier for Ensuring Faultless Drying of Products of a Special Purpose
abstract: The article is devoted to the modeling of drying process of the shaped ceramic products in batch-type chamber dryers. The main types of such products are considered, as well as the reasons for the appearance of rejects, which can reach 7% at the molding stage, 40% of the total lot at drying, and after kilning, all products that had a low quality of drying will have defects. Since the shaped products are sensitive to the temperature regime of drying, it is necessary to simulate the movement of heat-transfer agent flows to determine the rational design parameters of the dryer. To this end, several existing designs of chamber dryers with different ways of supplying and organizing the movement of the heat-transfer agent in the chamber space were designed, resulting in their 3D models. To eliminate the design drawbacks of existing dryers associated with uneven heat flow, there are proposed ways to improve them, associated with the organization of a directed supply of heat-transfer agent throughout the entire height of the chamber to obtain a uniform temperature field.

articleTitle: Information-Measuring Complex for Express-Diagnosing of Human Disease
abstract: The information-wave and IoT technologies-based information measuring complex for human diseases diagnostics has been developed. A tablet computer is used as a control device. The measurement module is developed on a microcontroller with a built-in Bluetooth and Wi-Fi module. The measuring module consists of an information wave generator and a human psychosomatic reactions sensor. The complex operates autonomously using the Bluetooth module or remotely through Cloud services and Wi-Fi connection. The accelerated technique of instant diagnostics of the most widespread human diseases has been offered. Experimental tests confirming the effectiveness of the complex have been carried out.

articleTitle: Modeling the Integral Indicator of the Quality of IT Services for Automated Control Systems Using Principle Component Analysis (PCA)
abstract: This paper develops a model of the Integral Indicator of the Quality of IT Services for Automated Control Systems using Principle Component Analysis (PCA) in the Open Source Software -GRETL- by calculating the first principle component based on six initial quality metrics of IT services. These quality metrics are selected from the following categories: incident control metrics, configuration control metrics, and change control metrics. As a result, the model of the integral indicator of quality for IT services suggested in this research allows for defining a cluster of the most efficient, according to the quality metrics, information systems included in the distributed automated control system.

articleTitle: Current Transformers: Transfer Functions, Frequency Response, and Static Measurement Error
abstract: This paper presents research into transient response with evidence from an enhanced current-transformer equivalent circuit. It shows the ratios of dynamic errors that occur when measuring the current in relative units; data are provided for various transformer states. The paper describes the peculiarities of transient response as observed when using current transformers with magnetic and nonmagnetic core gaps. Find here guidelines on configuring the current-transformer equivalent circuit elements, with such configuration serving as the input for the equivalent circuit under consideration. The paper presents a mathematical model of current-transformer transient response. The computer model and simulation data analysis have produced a valid finding that using current transformers as primary transducers for relay protection and automation in electric drives is not recommendable.

articleTitle: Tools of Data Transmission at Building Information Modeling
abstract: Modern technologies of modeling open new resources in the effective management of information flows in the construction industry. Communication between designers and builders at the level of the information model has an obstacle: different modeling systems have their own file formats. The methods of combining different parts of the model are proposed: a single description language, direct interfaces, the creation of a single platform. The article describes the possibilities of blockchain technology in the implementation of building information modeling technology. Assessment of the feasibility of using blockchain has shown that the use of technology is relevant to the growing number of actors. The analysis of the evolutionary model of Polterovich-Tonis in relation to the processes of information modeling.

articleTitle: Formation of the Model of Sustainable Development of Enterprises of the Mineral and Raw Materials Complex on the Basis of Geological and Economic Monitoring
abstract: One of the most important factors in the development of The relevance of the research is the development of a model of sustainable development of mineral and raw materials' sector enterprises based on the system approach covering all levels and functions of managing the subsoil fund, all stages of the geological exploration process and built using modern geo-information technologies and web systems that provide all interested users with up-to-date geological and economic information. The subject of the study is the methodological approach to conducting geological and economic monitoring with regard to the formation of a model for the sustainable development of enterprises in the mineral and raw materials' sector, including its organizational and economic foundations for the effective functioning of the mineral and raw materials' sector. The purpose of the study is the scientific and methodological justification of geological and economic monitoring and the methodology for its implementation in the management of enterprises of the mineral and raw materials' sector. The theoretical and methodological fundamentals of the research are based on the methods of system analysis and modeling, structural analysis and the control system design, process approach, methods of mathematical statistics and econometrics, correlation-regression analysis and forecasting, mapping and economic grouping methods, cluster approach and graph method. The system of geological and economic monitoring developed within the framework of the study is used by: the Federal Budget Institution “Territorial Fund of Geological Information for the Central Federal District” (Moscow).

articleTitle: BLE Beacon Interaction Module and Mobile Application in the Indoor-Navigation System
abstract: Modern mobile technologies are used for communication, search and storage of information, navigation. The article describes the experience of developing a mobile application for indoor navigation on Kemerovo State University campus. The indoor navigation is based on Bluetooth technologies and uses BLE-beacon. The paper deals with the algorithm of calculating the amount of BLE-beacon and their effective location in a building. The algorithm uses the measurement of received signal strength (RSS). It is based on trilateration and Kalman Filter. We present the mobile application “My guide” for indoor navigation. It lets define a smartphone owner's location relating to the signals of BLE-beacon in an academic building. The mobile application displays the zonal map and constructs a path. Our work is devoted to the development of available educational environment.

articleTitle: Environmental Resource Saving Biogas Production
abstract: The largest producer of poultry meat in the Far East of Russia, the poultry factory “Mikhailovsky Broiler”, in addition to food products, produces waste in large amounts in the form of bird manure. The manure is wasted if it is not recycled but simply stored. By trying to solve the problem of recycling and processing of bird manure, the enterprise has found a way that allows not only to neutralize a huge amount of waste of the fourth class, but also to produce a significant amount of methane gas. When methane is burned, thermal energy is produced that can be used year-round in the technological processes of the enterprise. The second, and no less valuable product of manure processing in the proposed technology is biohumus, which is in demand on local and international markets. In the course of test experiments of the technology in fermenting bird manure, the limitations inherent in the processing of pure poultry manure, other than ruminants' manure, have been clarified. For their elimination the processing technology has been significantly refined by the experts of the research organization, and has been patented. The practical justification for the anaerobic fermentation of the poultry manure was confirmed in the experimental reactor fabricated at the plant in 2011. The proposed manure processing solves the environmental problem, opens up additional sources of resource saving and additional profit for the enterprise. The selling of biohumus to agricultural enterprises in the region makes possible to significantly increase the yield of agricultural crops.
